verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an IP office's digital services, such as batch renewals, multi-mark updates or bulk searches, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents single-item actions like filing an application, renewing a trade mark, searching by number or owner, and updating or surrendering marks. Nothing shows a documented capability to act on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
